I didn't read a single page: not Enduring Word, Ellicott, Pulpit, Gill, Barnes, Wesley's Notes, Precept Austin or the NET Bible notes.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and to give a URL for every point. Since I have no page content, I've left out all notes on Job 27 rather than write them from memory.

If you ask again in a new message, the tool should be available again. I'll fetch the pages one or two at a time to stay under the limit, in this order:
1. **Traditional reading:** enduringword.com/bible-commentary/job-27/, then the Ellicott, Pulpit, Gill, Barnes and Wesley commentaries on Job 27 at biblehub.com, then preceptaustin.org.
2. **Modern scholarship:** the NET Bible notes on Job 27 at netbible.org. Most likely topics are the Hebrew of v. 5 and whether vv. 13–23 are Job's words or belong to a speech by another speaker, such as Zophar's "missing" third speech.
3. **Other traditions:** targeted searches for Job 27 on the denominational, Catholic and Orthodox sites. I'll only include those views where the pages actually discuss this chapter.
